summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to notify the market of a block admission application to the London Stock Exchange for 150,000 ordinary shares of US$0.20 each, expected to be admitted on 6 July 2026. The shares are reserved under a block admission and will be issued to settle awards under the company's employee share plans. The shares rank pari passu with existing ordinary shares. No price, premium, or special-situation terms are stated. This is a routine share issuance for employee compensation, not a special situation.
